_source: FedALA (Zhang et al., AAAI 2023) — severe variant
_description: Extreme pathological setting from FedALA ablation: 20 clients, each with only 5 classes out of 100. Each class appears in 1 client (20×5/100=1). With 500 samples/label, each client gets 2500 training samples but sees only 5% of classes — maximum label isolation.
